identification: New Afghan flatweave (kilim) runner, 293 x 83 cm, hand woven wool, taupe-grey field with two rows of stepped diamond medallions in cream, saffron yellow, rust red, sky blue and lilac, serrated cream border, fringed ends. This is the modern Afghan 'Chobi / Maimana kilim' production sold in huge numbers by importers, here catalogued as 'Kazak' with a dealer's authenticity card (#403). New, not antique. Cloud scan correct.
